releases.name: v0.1.0 — initial release
releases.body:
Initial release of **opencode-tokenomics** — a real-time, per-project **token usage & cost** dashboard for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai).

On OpenCode startup the plugin boots a small local web server and opens a live dashboard in your browser, streaming spend as you work — split by project, model, and subagent.

### Highlights
- **Live spend** — total USD cost, tokens and API calls, updated in real time over SSE.
- **Per-project split** — usage keyed by project root, navigable from a searchable, sortable sidebar.
- **Agents & subagents** — delegation tree with who / what / how much / how long per session.
- **Agent × model** and **by-model** breakdowns.
- **Cache efficiency** — hit rate and the *real* money caching saved (never phantom savings on free/self-hosted usage).
- **Token distribution** and **context breakdown** (system prompt, tool defs, environment, project tree, instructions).
- **Tool & skill usage** — per-tool calls, failures, output tokens, complexity; loaded skills and their token cost.
- **Charts** — cumulative spend, spend over time by model, tokens by day, activity by hour, cost efficiency ($/M).
- **Configurable cards** — toggle any card; hidden cards are also skipped in computation.
- **Real vs estimated cost** — free models read `$0`; subscription/zen plans show a clearly labeled `~$x` estimate.

### Install
Add to your OpenCode config (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`):

```json
{ "plugin": ["@aeondave/opencode-tokenomics@latest"] }
```

See the [README](https://github.com/AeonDave/opencode-tokenomics#readme) for from-source setup and configuration.
